# The advanced-config counter records backend creation after confirmation

The advanced-config label uses successfulEmailAccountSetup, whose declared purpose is counting successful setup by configuration source. Both historical handlers increment after awaiting backend creation. The accepted Hub still checks duplicates and confirmation first, increments after creation, then opens Account Settings. A click that is cancelled or fails before creation does not reach this increment; opening settings happens after counting. The added browser test resets telemetry and directly checks one advanced-config success. It does not test every click, failed creation or successful server authentication.

Scope: Thunderbird account-creation telemetry.
